fact: Nostr IDs must never be truncated in code, logs, tests, analytics, or debug output; UI layout should handle overflow visually instead.
recommendation: Search for any shortened npub, nsec, event ID, or pubkey handling before committing Nostr-related changes.

fact: Divine Brain credentials are sensitive CF Access headers or service tokens and must not be committed to repository files.
recommendation: Keep Divine Brain auth in developer-local/global MCP configuration. If Brain returns 403 or is unavailable, report the missing local MCP auth instead of adding credentials to .mcp.json.

fact: Metaswarm's BEADS priming requires the bd CLI; without bd, automatic prime output will be absent even if .beads/knowledge exists.
recommendation: If bd is unavailable, read .beads/knowledge/*.jsonl directly and mention that automatic BEADS priming is disabled until bd is installed.
